description:
Follow-up to remediate-coverage-theater (completed 2026-03-05). That work
removed the worst offenders (17 hollow files, enforcement scripts) and added
real connection tests. This TODO addresses the remaining systemic issues
found in the post-remediation audit:

Current state (2026-03-06):
- 13,350 "fast" tests take 25+ minutes single-threaded (should be <5 min)
- 3,350 trivial assertions (isinstance, is not None, len > 0) across suite
- 1,605 MagicMock instances across 321 files (top 2 replaceable: 124 mocks)
- Root conftest.py is 746 lines combining unrelated concerns
- 9 avoidable time.sleep calls in test_tpc_compliance.py
- 5 thin test files (<200 lines) that should merge into their main adapter files
- 79 hollow isinstance assertions in 4 files testing guaranteed return types

Seven work units across three phases:
Phase 1 (independent): fast suite profiling, sleep removal, assertion strengthening
Phase 2 (depends on w2): isinstance cleanup, MagicMock reduction
Phase 3 (depends on w1): conftest decomposition, test file consolidation

anti_patterns.why: the suite already has 1,605 instances and mock density is a known problem

anti_patterns.dont: attempt MagicMock reduction in cloud-only platform tests
anti_patterns.instead: mocking is the correct approach for those

anti_patterns.dont: delete test files without merging their tests first
anti_patterns.instead: move tests to the target file, then delete the source
anti_patterns.why: every test file in scope has real value

anti_patterns.instead: run affected tests after each fixture move
anti_patterns.why: conftest.py fixtures are auto-discovered by pytest scope and moving them changes availability

anti_patterns.instead: only replace where the return type is guaranteed by the function signature
anti_patterns.why: expression wrapper types (UnifiedExpr, pl.Expr) and C binary wrapper types are API contracts

deferrals.reason: Mostly cloud-only platforms where mocking is unavoidable. Address opportunistically when those adapters are modified for other work.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] non-actionable: Vague, large-scope 'opportunistic' MagicMock reduction across ~319 cloud-only-platform test files with no concrete plan or owner.
deferrals.summary: Reduce MagicMock in remaining 319 files (~1,460 instances after w6)

deferrals.reason: Only ~23 assertions in mixed category. Diminishing returns after w4 handles the 79 clearly hollow ones.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] non-actionable: Explicit diminishing-returns call on ~23 mixed assertions after the 79 clearly hollow ones were fixed in w4; not worth a separate item.
deferrals.summary: Strengthen isinstance in meaningful-but-weak files (test_system_info.py mixed assertions)

preserves.behavior: All existing tests must continue to pass - marker changes only affect which suite they run in
CI fast suite (make test-fast) must still work with updated markers
Cloud platform test files must keep MagicMock - no real connection alternative exists for Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, etc.
Consolidated tests must preserve all test methods - merge means zero test loss
Meaningful isinstance assertions must be kept - only replace hollow ones where the type is guaranteed by the function signature
Root conftest parallel locking behavior must be preserved across the split
tests/unit/core/test_dataframe_queries_coverage_wave_remaining.py must be kept (has real Polars execution)

work_units.summary: Profile fast suite to identify tests falsely marked fast, and fix markers
Strengthen assertions in the 5 worst is-not-None-heavy test files
Remove 9 avoidable time.sleep calls from test_tpc_compliance.py
Replace hollow isinstance assertions in 4 files with behavioral checks
Consolidate 5 thin platform test files into their main adapter test files
Replace MagicMock with real connections in test_platform_adapters_coverage_wave_remaining.py and test_dataframe_runner.py
Split root conftest.py into domain-specific conftest files
